risk_if_not_implemented: Without Capabilities Deficiency Tracking, executive management, the Board of Directors (BoD) and assessors may rely on inaccurate, incomplete or unverifiable control and risk information. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Vulnerability Remediation Process
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure that vulnerabilities are properly identified, tracked and remediated.
compensating_control_1.justification: Vulnerability Remediation Process (VPM-06) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Capabilities Deficiency Tracking (IAO-12) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to remediate risks to an acceptable level.
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Remediation (RSK-17) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Capabilities Deficiency Tracking (IAO-12) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged.
